notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 152 from 2 September 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/5y3KdXwOHAdEiERuX1NtGR?si=87414268eb9642d6) with @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for dealing with groups of Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with a solar build. High-impact pulse rifles provide better accuracy when moving 2.8m/s or less - ×0.8 accuracy cone size and ×0.83 accuracy cone growth - but are unfortunately the worst subfamily for damage output. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are fine, and they're helped at Tier 4/5 when barrel and mag perks are enhanced - d2foundry.gg calculates that 62 Range equates to 20.65m hipfire and 33.04m ADS before damage dropoff, 43 Stability is ×1.0575 flinch resist, 23 Handling is 0.47s ready, 0.41s ADS and 0.47s stow speed, 34 Reload Speed is 2.16s reload and Magazine Size is 27 (max 48) - at three bullets for trigger pull that's 9 shots. Controllers could probably do with a little help controlling recoil with the barrel perk, otherwise look to boost handling. For the magazine perk look to boost Reload Speed. The always-popular solar trait perk combination of Heal Clip for the ×2 Cure (140 HP) and ×1 Cure on allies within 15m when you finish a reload within 5.3s after a kill, and Incandescent which is great for crowd control, spreading +30 Scorch stacks to adds within 4m on a Minor add kill (+45 stacks within 8m for orange and yellow bars). The scorch stacks are all increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. Roar of Battle's +10 Handling and Stability is unspectacular, so Wild Card is the better Origin Trait for the chance of Telesto-like "Experimental Submunitions" on a kill. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
